# The Bukit Besi Tools

> 55 free online tools for code, SEO, writing, images and AI, plus Malaysian salary, zakat and BMI calculators. No signup needed.

This site hosts its own calculators and a directory of free tools, most of which run on https://www.thebukitbesi.com/. Tools on this site run in the browser and do not send inputs to this site. Last updated 2026-10-12.

## Tools and calculators on this site

- [Car Loan Calculator Malaysia 2026: Monthly Instalment, EIR & Flat](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/car-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian car loan (hire purchase) instalments by the reducing-balance method with an effective interest rate (EIR), required by the Hire-Purchase (Amendment) Act from 1 June 2026 with a transition to 31 March 2027, or by the older flat-rate method; converts flat rate to EIR and back; shows total interest, a yearly schedule and the early settlement amount, including the Rule of 78 rebate for older flat-rate agreements.
- [CGPA Calculator: SGPA to CGPA and GPA from Grades](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-calculator/): Calculates CGPA from semester SGPAs (credit-weighted, or a simple average without credits) and GPA/CGPA from course letter grades on the UGC 10-point scale (O, A+, A … P, F) or the Malaysian 4.00 scale (A 4.00, A− 3.67, B+ 3.33 …), including continuing from a previous CGPA.
- [CGPA to Percentage Calculator: VTU, AKTU, SPPU, CBSE & More](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-to-percentage/): Converts CGPA to percentage (and percentage back to CGPA) with the formula each university commonly publishes: CBSE CGPA × 9.5, VTU/AKTU/MAKAUT/SPPU (CGPA − 0.75) × 10, GTU (CGPA − 0.5) × 10, University of Mumbai CGPA × 7.1 + 11, Anna University CGPA × 10, any-scale proportional and custom formulas, with a full CGPA 5.0–10.0 conversion table.
- [City-Link Tracking: Track Your City-Link Express Parcel](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/citylink-tracking/): City-Link Express tracking: opens City-Link's official tracking page for a consignment number, explains the number format, common statuses, what to do when a delivery fails, and background on City-Link Express, founded in 1979 as Malaysia's first locally owned courier.
- [CSS Minifier: Minify & Compress CSS Online Free](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/css-minifier/): Minifies CSS in the browser: removes comments (keeps /*! licence comments), whitespace and last semicolons, shortens colours (#ffffff to #fff), numbers (0.50em to .5em) and zero lengths (0px to 0), and drops empty rules, without touching strings, url() values, custom properties or spaces inside calc(). Shows original, minified and gzip size; can also beautify (unminify) CSS. Tested against Bootstrap 5.3.3: 281,046 to 232,701 bytes with identical rendering. CSS is never uploaded.
- [EPF Calculator Malaysia 2026: KWSP Dividend & Retirement](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/epf-calculator/): Projects EPF (KWSP) savings to age 55 or 60 from age, salary, yearly raise, current balances in Akaun Persaraan, Sejahtera and Fleksibel, own contribution rate and voluntary top-ups, using the KWSP Third Schedule, the 75/15/10 account split and EPF's dividend method; compares the inflation-adjusted result with EPF's Basic (RM390,000), Adequate (RM650,000) and Enhanced (RM1.3 million) benchmarks. Includes dividend history 2016–2025 (2025: 6.15%).
- [GDEX Tracking: Track Your GDEX Parcel in Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/gdex-tracking/): GDEX (GD Express) tracking: opens GDEX's official tracking page for a consignment note number, explains the number format, common GDEX statuses, what to do when a parcel is undelivered, and background on GD Express Carrier Bhd.
- [Home Loan Calculator Malaysia 2026: Instalment, Stamp Duty & DSR](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/home-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates the monthly instalment of a Malaysian housing loan (monthly rest), total interest, a yearly amortisation table and savings from extra monthly payments; estimates upfront costs: down payment, stamp duty on the transfer (1%/2%/3%/4% scale) and loan agreement (0.5%), SRO 2023 legal fees (1.25% of the first RM500,000, 1% after) plus 8% SST, and the first-home stamp duty exemption (current RM500,000 rule and the Budget 2027 RM750,000 proposal); checks the debt service ratio and the maximum loan for an income. OPR 2.75% since 9 July 2025.
- [Income Tax Calculator Malaysia YA2026 & Budget 2027](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/income-tax-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates Malaysian resident individual income tax for YA2026 (income earned in 2026, filed in 2027) from annual income, every personal relief with its limit, approved donations, the RM400 rebate, zakat and PCB already paid (refund or balance), and compares it with the Budget 2027 proposal (RM12,000 individual relief, 18% and 24% bands, 30% above RM1 million) for YA2027.
- [J&T Near Me: Find the Nearest J&T Express Drop Point](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-near-me/): Finds J&T Express drop points near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains how to send a parcel at a J&T drop point, opening hours, marketplace drop-offs and what to bring.
- [J&T Terdekat: Cari Drop Point J&T Express Berhampiran](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-terdekat/): Mencari drop point J&T Express berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan cara menghantar parcel di drop point J&T, waktu operasi, penghantaran pesanan marketplace dan apa perlu dibawa.
- [J&T Tracking Malaysia: Track Your J&T Express Parcel](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/jnt-tracking/): J&T Express Malaysia tracking: opens J&T Malaysia's official tracking page for a waybill number (usually 12 digits), explains J&T statuses such as Picked Up, Arrival, Departure, On Delivery and On Hold, why scans have gaps and when to contact the seller or J&T.
- [Kalkulator Cukai Pendapatan TT2026 & Bajet 2027](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-cukai-pendapatan/): Kalkulator cukai pendapatan individu pemastautin Malaysia bagi TT2026 (pendapatan 2026, diisytihar pada 2027): pendapatan tahunan, setiap pelepasan cukai dengan hadnya, derma diluluskan, rebat RM400, zakat dan PCB yang telah dipotong (bayaran balik atau baki), berserta perbandingan dengan cadangan Bajet 2027 (pelepasan individu RM12,000, kadar 18% dan 24%, 30% melebihi RM1 juta) bagi TT2027.
- [Kalkulator Gaji Bersih 2026: PCB, KWSP, PERKESO & SIP](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-gaji/): Kalkulator gaji bersih Malaysia 2026 (Bahasa Melayu): potongan KWSP mengikut Jadual Ketiga, PERKESO, SIP dan LINDUNG 24 Jam (siling RM6,000) serta PCB/MTD mengikut kaedah pengiraan berkomputer LHDN, termasuk kos majikan.
- [Kalkulator KWSP 2026: Dividen & Simpanan Persaraan](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-kwsp/): Kalkulator KWSP (Bahasa Melayu): unjuran simpanan hingga umur 55 atau 60 berdasarkan umur, gaji, kenaikan gaji tahunan, baki semasa Akaun Persaraan, Sejahtera dan Fleksibel, kadar caruman sendiri dan caruman sukarela, mengikut Jadual Ketiga KWSP, pembahagian 75/15/10 dan kaedah dividen KWSP; membandingkan nilai selepas inflasi dengan tahap Asas (RM390,000), Mencukupi (RM650,000) dan Dipertingkat (RM1.3 juta). Termasuk sejarah dividen 2016–2025 (2025: 6.15%).
- [Kalkulator Loan Kereta 2026: Ansuran Bulanan, EIR & Kadar Rata](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-loan-kereta/): Mengira ansuran pinjaman kereta (sewa beli) Malaysia dengan kaedah baki berkurangan dan kadar faedah efektif (EIR), diwajibkan oleh Akta Sewa Beli (Pindaan) mulai 1 Jun 2026 dengan peralihan hingga 31 Mac 2027, atau kaedah kadar rata lama; menukar kadar rata kepada EIR dan sebaliknya; menunjukkan jumlah faedah, jadual tahunan dan jumlah penyelesaian awal termasuk rebat Rule of 78 bagi perjanjian kadar rata lama.
- [Kalkulator Pinjaman Perumahan 2026: Ansuran Loan Rumah, Duti Setem](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/kalkulator-pinjaman-perumahan/): Mengira ansuran bulanan pinjaman perumahan Malaysia (rehat bulanan), jumlah faedah, jadual tahunan dan penjimatan bayaran tambahan; menganggar kos awal: wang pendahuluan, duti setem pindah milik (skala 1%/2%/3%/4%) dan perjanjian pinjaman (0.5%), yuran guaman SRO 2023 (1.25% bagi RM500,000 pertama, 1% seterusnya) serta SST 8%, dan pengecualian duti setem rumah pertama (peraturan semasa RM500,000 dan cadangan Bajet 2027 RM750,000); menyemak nisbah khidmat hutang (DSR) dan pinjaman maksimum. OPR 2.75% sejak 9 Julai 2025.
- [Ninja Van Near Me: Find the Nearest Ninja Point to Drop Off](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-near-me/): Finds Ninja Van Ninja Points (pick-up and drop-off partner shops) near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains dropping off, collecting a missed delivery, returns and opening hours.
- [Ninja Van Terdekat: Cari Ninja Point Berhampiran Anda](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-terdekat/): Mencari Ninja Point Ninja Van (kedai rakan untuk ambil dan hantar parcel) berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan cara menghantar, mengambil parcel yang terlepas, pemulangan dan waktu operasi.
- [Ninja Van Tracking Malaysia: Track Your Parcel & Ninja Points](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/ninja-van-tracking/): Ninja Van Malaysia tracking: opens Ninja Van's official tracking page for a tracking ID (usually starting NV, NVMY or MYNJV), explains statuses such as Pending Pickup, Re-attempt, To Collect and Returned to Sender, and how Ninja Point pick-up and drop-off locations work.
- [Parcel Tracking Malaysia: Track Pos Laju, J&T, SPX & Ninja Van](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/parcel-tracking-malaysia/): Identifies the Malaysian courier from a tracking number's format (Pos Laju, J&T Express, SPX Express, Ninja Van, DHL, GDEX, City-Link, Flash Express, Lazada LEX, Skynet, Line Clear, Aramex, FedEx, UPS) and opens that courier's official tracking page with the number copied; explains tracking number formats, what each tracking status means and what to do when a parcel stops moving. Runs in the browser; numbers are never sent to this site.
- [Pos Laju Near Me: Find the Nearest Post Office Open Now](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-near-me/): Finds Pos Malaysia post offices and Pos Laju outlets near the visitor by opening a Google Maps search at their location or a typed area; explains counter hours, state weekend differences, sending a Pos Laju parcel and collecting one.
- [Pos Laju Terdekat: Cari Pejabat Pos Berhampiran Anda](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-terdekat/): Mencari pejabat pos Pos Malaysia dan cawangan Pos Laju berhampiran pelawat dengan membuka carian Google Maps di lokasi mereka atau kawasan yang ditaip; menerangkan waktu kaunter, perbezaan hujung minggu mengikut negeri, menghantar dan mengambil parcel Pos Laju.
- [Pos Laju Tracking: Track Your Parcel & Status Meanings](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/pos-laju-tracking/): Pos Laju (Pos Malaysia) tracking: opens the official Pos Malaysia tracking page for a 13-character S10 tracking number, explains the number format and its service letters, each Pos Laju status, and collecting a parcel from a post office.
- [Malaysia Salary Calculator 2026: PCB, EPF, SOCSO & EIS](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/salary-calculator-malaysia/): Calculates 2026 Malaysian take-home pay from gross monthly salary: EPF (KWSP Third Schedule), SOCSO, EIS, LINDUNG 24 Jam (PERKESO, RM6,000 ceiling) and PCB/MTD tax (LHDN computerised method), with employer cost and a table of net pay at common salaries.
- [Semak Tracking City-Link: Status Parcel City-Link Express](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-citylink/): Semak tracking City-Link Express: membuka laman tracking rasmi City-Link untuk nombor konsainan, menerangkan format nombor, status biasa, tindakan jika penghantaran gagal, dan latar belakang City-Link Express yang ditubuhkan pada 1979 sebagai kurier milik tempatan pertama Malaysia.
- [Semak Tracking GDEX: Status Parcel GDEX Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-gdex/): Semak tracking GDEX (GD Express): membuka laman tracking rasmi GDEX untuk nombor nota konsainan, menerangkan format nombor, status GDEX biasa, tindakan jika parcel gagal dihantar, dan latar belakang GD Express Carrier Bhd.
- [Semak Tracking J&T Express: Status Parcel J&T Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-jnt/): Semak tracking J&T Express Malaysia: membuka laman tracking rasmi J&T Malaysia untuk nombor waybill (biasanya 12 digit), menerangkan status J&T seperti Picked Up, Arrival, Departure, On Delivery dan On Hold, kenapa ada jurang antara imbasan dan bila perlu menghubungi penjual atau J&T.
- [Semak Tracking Ninja Van: Status Parcel & Ninja Point](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-ninja-van/): Semak tracking Ninja Van Malaysia: membuka laman tracking rasmi Ninja Van untuk ID tracking (biasanya bermula NV, NVMY atau MYNJV), menerangkan status seperti Pending Pickup, Re-attempt, To Collect dan Returned to Sender, serta cara Ninja Point berfungsi.
- [Semak Tracking Parcel: Semua Kurier Malaysia (Pos Laju, J&T, SPX)](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-parcel/): Versi Bahasa Melayu: mengenal pasti kurier Malaysia daripada format nombor tracking (Pos Laju, J&T Express, SPX Express, Ninja Van, DHL, GDEX, City-Link, Flash Express, Lazada LEX, Skynet, Line Clear, Aramex, FedEx, UPS) dan membuka laman tracking rasmi kurier dengan nombor telah disalin; menerangkan format nombor tracking, maksud status tracking dan tindakan jika parcel tidak bergerak.
- [Semak Tracking Pos Laju: Status Parcel & Maksudnya](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/semak-tracking-pos-laju/): Semak tracking Pos Laju (Pos Malaysia): membuka laman tracking rasmi Pos Malaysia untuk nombor S10 13 aksara, menerangkan format nombor, maksud huruf perkhidmatan, setiap status Pos Laju dan cara mengambil parcel di pejabat pos.

## Directory

- [Free online tools](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/): Canonical directory with tool descriptions, categories and usage guidance.

## Developer Tools

- [JavaScript Minifier & Obfuscator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/javascript-minifier-obfuscator.html): Minify JavaScript and configure obfuscation options to reduce file size and transform your code.
- [CSS Minifier](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/css-minifier/): Compress CSS by removing unnecessary whitespace and comments, then copy or download the result.
- [HTML Beautifier & Minifier](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/html-beautifier-online.html): Format messy HTML for readability or minify it for a smaller file in one tool.
- [Parse HTML Online](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/parse-html.html): Escape HTML and AdSense snippets for use in Blogger XML templates.
- [HTML Table Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/html-table-generator.html): Build HTML tables with customizable styles and copy the generated markup.
- [JSON Formatter & Validator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/json-formatter-validator.html): Validate, beautify or minify JSON, sort keys and inspect formatting errors.
- [Parser & Unparser Tool](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/parser-unparser.html): Convert structured data into strings and parse supported data formats back into usable values.
- [GitHub Link Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/github-link-converter.html): Turn public GitHub file links into jsDelivr CDN URLs for embedding assets.
- [JavaScript Minifier](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/best-javascript-minifier-online.html): Compress JavaScript and review the output size before copying or downloading your file.

## SEO Tools

- [JSON-LD Schema Markup Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/json-schema-markup-generator.html): Generate structured data for articles, organizations, local businesses and other supported page types.
- [Video Schema Markup Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/video-schema-markup-generator.html): Create VideoObject JSON-LD from your video details for use on your website.
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/robotstxt-generator.html): Build robots.txt rules for user agents, crawl paths and sitemap locations.
- [SEO Meta Analyzer](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/seo-meta-analyzer-tool.html): Check title and description lengths and preview how your text could appear in search results.
- [FAQ Formatter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/faq-formatter-tool.html): Turn question-and-answer text into HTML and matching FAQPage JSON-LD markup.
- [Word Counter & Keyword Density Checker](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/free-word-counter-seo-keyword-density.html): Count words, inspect keyword frequency and estimate reading time for your content.

## Content Tools

- [Word Counter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/word-counter.html): Count words, characters and sentences and review reading-time estimates as you type.
- [Text & Character Remover](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/remove-characters-from-text.html): Clean text by removing selected characters, numbers, punctuation or extra spaces.
- [Text to HTML Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/text-to-html-converter.html): Convert plain text into HTML paragraphs, lists and links, then copy or download the output.
- [Find & Replace Text](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/find-replace-text.html): Apply multiple replacement rules to text, with regular expressions and highlighted matches.
- [Text Case Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/convert-case.html): Switch between uppercase, lowercase, title case and developer naming styles such as camelCase.
- [Online Notepad](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/online-notepad.html): Write notes with autosave, snapshots, word counts and TXT or Markdown import and export.

## Design Tools

- [WebP Image Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/webp-image-converter.html): Batch-convert images to WebP with resizing and compression controls.
- [Image Format Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/image-converter.html): Convert images between supported formats and download batch results as a ZIP file.
- [Color Contrast Checker](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/color-contrast.html): Compare text and background colors and check WCAG AA and AAA contrast ratios.
- [Online Photo Editor](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/online-photoshop.html): Edit images with layers, brushes, shapes and filters, then export your work.
- [WhatsApp Sticker Editor](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/sticker-whatsapp-maker.html): Create individual stickers with text, filters, outlines and export controls.
- [WhatsApp Sticker Pack Maker](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/whatsapp-sticker-maker.html): Prepare multiple stickers, customize pack details and download the files together.

## AI Tools

- [AI Art Prompt Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/ai-art-prompt-optimizer-create-perfect.html): Build image prompts from a subject, art style, details and negative prompts.
- [AI Image Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/free-ai-image-generator.html): Create images from text prompts using the generation options on the tool page.
- [AI Video Prompt Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/ai-video-prompt.html): Compose detailed prompts for image and video generation models.
- [Image to Prompt](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/image-to-prompt.html): Use an image as a starting point for a prompt and refine the resulting text.
- [AI Paraphraser & Grammar Checker](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/ai-paraphraser-tool.html): Rewrite text and explore grammar, tone and other writing options on the tool page.
- [AI Cartoonizer](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/cartoonizer-ai-tool.html): Apply cartoon-style effects to an uploaded image and download the result.

## Utilities

- [Privacy Policy Generator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/free-privacy-policy-generator.html): Draft a privacy policy from your website details and review it before publishing.
- [Link Generator & Protector](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/secure-link-generator.html): Create encoded links, UTM tracking URLs and QR codes. Encoding is not encryption.
- [WhatsApp Link Creator](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/whatsapp-link-creator.html): Create WhatsApp chat links with a preset message, QR code and bulk link options.
- [Parcel Tracking Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/parcel-tracking-malaysia/): Paste any tracking number to identify the courier and open its official tracking page: Pos Laju, J&T, SPX, Ninja Van, DHL, GDEX and more. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [PDF & Word Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/pdf-converter.html): Convert PDF and Word documents or combine images into a PDF using supported options.
- [Malaysia Currency Converter](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/currency-converter-malaysia.html): Convert MYR and other supported currencies using the exchange-rate data available in the tool.
- [TM Unifi Speed Test](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/tm-speed-test.html): Measure download, upload, ping and jitter for your internet connection.
- [Internet Speed Test](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/internet-speed-test.html): Run an internet speed test and review bandwidth and connection latency.

## Calculators

- [Malaysia Salary Calculator](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/salary-calculator-malaysia/): Work out 2026 take-home pay after EPF, SOCSO, EIS, LINDUNG 24 Jam and PCB tax, plus your employer's cost. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [Income Tax Calculator Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/income-tax-calculator-malaysia/): Work out YA2026 income tax with every LHDN relief, rebates, zakat and a PCB refund check, and compare it with the Budget 2027 proposal. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [Car Loan Calculator Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/car-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Monthly car loan instalment under the 2026 hire purchase rules: EIR or flat rate, flat-to-EIR conversion, total interest and early settlement with the Rule of 78. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [Home Loan Calculator Malaysia](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/home-loan-calculator-malaysia/): Work out your monthly housing loan instalment, total interest, stamp duty and SRO 2023 legal fees, the first-home exemption and how much you can borrow. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [EPF Calculator (KWSP)](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/epf-calculator/): Project your EPF savings to 55 or 60 with the latest 6.15% dividend, see Akaun Persaraan, Sejahtera and Fleksibel, and check EPF's retirement targets. English and Bahasa Melayu.
- [CGPA to Percentage Calculator](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-to-percentage/): Convert CGPA to percentage with your university's formula: CBSE, VTU, AKTU, MAKAUT, SPPU, GTU, Mumbai and Anna, plus a full conversion table.
- [CGPA Calculator](https://tool.thebukitbesi.com/cgpa-calculator/): Turn semester SGPAs into a credit-weighted CGPA, or course grades into GPA on India's 10-point or Malaysia's 4.00 scale.
- [Kalkulator Faraid](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-faraid.html): Estimate Islamic inheritance shares for supported family scenarios and review the breakdown.
- [Kalkulator Zakat](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-zakat.html): Estimate zakat for income, savings, gold and other supported categories using the tool settings.
- [Pregnancy Dates & Test Timing](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-jantina-bayi.html): Estimate gestational age and view NIPT or ultrasound timing from your pregnancy dates.
- [Kalkulator Saiz Kasut](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-saiz-kasut.html): Convert shoe sizes between UK, US, EU and centimeter measurements.
- [Kalkulator Kalori](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-kalori.html): Estimate BMR, daily calorie needs and macronutrients from your activity and body measurements.
- [Kalkulator BMI (Bahasa Melayu)](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/kalkulator-bmi.html): Calculate BMI with a Malay-language interface and review the categories shown by the tool.
- [BMI Calculator Malaysia (English)](https://www.thebukitbesi.com/p/bmi-calculator-malaysia.html): Calculate BMI using metric or imperial measurements with an English-language interface.
